import itertools

RIDERS = ["Reynaldo", "Seamus", "Theresa", "Yuki"]
BIKES = ["F", "G", "H", "J"]
R, S, T, Y = RIDERS
SUBMITTED = "A"


def scenarios(both_days):
    """Exhaustively enumerate every valid two-day assignment with Theresa on J on day 1.
    both_days=True applies the F and J restrictions to both days;
    both_days=False applies them to day 1 only. Both readings are checked."""
    out = []
    for p1perm in itertools.permutations(BIKES):
        p1 = dict(zip(RIDERS, p1perm))
        for p2perm in itertools.permutations(BIKES):
            p2 = dict(zip(RIDERS, p2perm))
            if p1[T] != "J":                                   # given condition
                continue
            if any(p1[r] == p2[r] for r in RIDERS):            # different bike each day
                continue
            if p1[R] == "F" or (both_days and p2[R] == "F"):   # Reynaldo cannot test F
                continue
            if p1[Y] == "J" or (both_days and p2[Y] == "J"):   # Yuki cannot test J
                continue
            if not (p1[T] == "H" or p2[T] == "H"):             # Theresa tests H on some day
                continue
            if p2[S] != p1[Y]:                                 # Seamus day 2 = Yuki day 1 bike
                continue
            out.append((p1, p2))
    return out


OPTIONS = {
    "A": ("Reynaldo tests G on the second day",
          lambda a, b: b[R] == "G"),
    "B": ("Seamus tests H on the first day",
          lambda a, b: a[S] == "H"),
    "C": ("Yuki tests H on the second day",
          lambda a, b: b[Y] == "H"),
    "D": ("Seamus is one of the testers for J",
          lambda a, b: "J" in (a[S], b[S])),
    "E": ("Theresa is one of the testers for G",
          lambda a, b: "G" in (a[T], b[T])),
}


def fmt(p):
    return "{" + ", ".join(f"{r}:{p[r]}" for r in RIDERS) + "}"


for both_days in (True, False):
    sc = scenarios(both_days)
    label = "restrictions on both days" if both_days else "restrictions on day 1 only"
    print(f"== {label}: valid scenarios = {len(sc)}")
    possible = []
    for key, (text, pred) in OPTIONS.items():
        witness = next(((a, b) for a, b in sc if pred(a, b)), None)
        if witness:
            possible.append(key)
            a, b = witness
            print(f"  {key} POSSIBLE: {text}; day1={fmt(a)} day2={fmt(b)}")
        else:
            print(f"  {key} impossible: {text}")
    print(f"  options that could be true: {possible}")

sc = scenarios(True)
text, pred = OPTIONS[SUBMITTED]
if any(pred(a, b) for a, b in sc):
    print(f"CHECK FAIL: submitted {SUBMITTED} ({text}) has a valid witness")
else:
    print(f"CHECK FAIL: submitted {SUBMITTED} ({text}) is never true in any valid scenario")

correct = [k for k, (_, p) in OPTIONS.items() if any(p(a, b) for a, b in sc)]
print(f"Correct option by exhaustive enumeration: {correct}")
print("CHECK PASS: answer B is the only option that could be true" if correct == ["B"]
      else "CHECK UNKNOWN: unexpected option set")
